chunks: From him, from his father, from one who narrated to him, from Abd al-Rahman al-Arzmee, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no harm if a man eats while he is walking; the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) used to do that.'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no harm / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat while walking in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes the permissibility (jawaz) of eating while walking, citing the practice of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) as the precedent. It is a legal ruling regarding daily etiquette and consumption.
